question: Does day-5 strength relate to return earned after day 5 once its direct arithmetic contribution to terminal return is removed?
mechanism: If V1's right tail is a persistence process rather than merely early outcome separation, stronger day-5 paths should continue to earn higher multiplicatively residual returns under the frozen holding path.
prediction: Day-5 return has a positive, stable association with multiplicatively residual terminal return after day 5; fixed day-10/day-20 survivor confirmations retain the direction.
interpretation_boundary: Residualization removes direct shared arithmetic only. The analysis remains conditional on survival through each landmark and on the frozen exit mechanism, and cannot establish a deployable hold or exit rule.

sample.primary: all 295 accepted EXP-PEL-001 cycles observable through day 5
sample.missingness: No imputation or post-exit extension. Day-10/day-20 use their own fixed survivor samples and cannot replace day 5.

primary_endpoint: multiplicatively residual round-trip return after day 5
fixed_neighbors: return_10d versus residual return after day 10 in the 192-cycle survivor sample
return_20d versus residual return after day 20 in the 91-cycle survivor sample

gates.raw: rho >= 0.10, positive within-year rank rho, and positive in >=7/8 LOYO estimates
gates.controlled: pre-entry partial-rank rho >= 0.10 and positive in >=7/8 controlled LOYO estimates
gates.mechanical: duration/exit partial-rank rho >= 0.05 with >=7/8 LOYO positive, positive ex-global-Top-4 P&L and ex-severe-loss estimates, and >=80% positive leave-one-security and leave-one-industry omissions
gates.neighbors: day-10 and day-20 residual-return rhos positive with >=6/8 LOYO positive signs; neither can replace day 5
gates.stable_giveback: raw rho <= -0.10 with negative sign in >=7/8 LOYO estimates

decision.DEEPEN: raw, controlled, mechanical, and neighbor gates pass
decision.REFINE: raw, controlled, and mechanical gates pass but later landmarks fail
decision.REJECT: none of the preceding conditions pass

falsification: exact multiplicative reconstruction with maximum error <= 1e-12
within-entry-year ranks, per-year estimates, and eight LOYO omissions
fixed pre-entry V1, market, breadth, beta, volatility, and liquidity controls
holding duration and canonical exit reason sensitivity
zero post-exit prices, counterfactual paths, replays, or strategy rules
forbidden: calling residual association a causal or deployable hold signal
testing an exit, stop, hold, ranking, sizing, entry, or production change
changing the landmark, residual formula, sample, controls, or gates after results
imputing returns after an actual exit
breadth historical redesign or invalid Phase 7/8/9 use
